sum_insured_options: ₹5L – ₹20L (based on sub-limit table; exact range not fully specified)

room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy, attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Optional voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount. 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims if optional 'Cashless Discount' cover is opted.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sub-limit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, gall bladder, spine, cancer, kidney, liver disease etc.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Optional voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10,000–₹3,00,000 available for premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required. Reducible via portability credit from prior insurer.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, organ transplant, hysterectomy, calculi, arthroplasty, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional Super Cumulative Bonus add-on offers up to 200% at 25%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims. Subsequent hospitalisation must be after 2-day gap (waived for different insured person).

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list provided; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI; must exceed 3 days. Excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, psychiatric disorders, vector-borne diseases, gastroenteritis, arthritis, etc.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to In-patient SI. Minimum 24-hour admission required. OPD and comfort treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Donor harvesting expenses covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Reinstatement benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered at reasonable & customary charges up to In-patient SI. Covers transfer to nearest hospital and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered (robotic surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.) up to SI. Reinstatement and CB not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Non-medical items listed in Annexure II are excluded. No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim can be contested except for fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual premium; 15 days for monthly instalment.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period at inception only; not applicable at renewal or porting.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, maternity excluded, domiciliary excludes diabetes/hypertension/asthma, external congenital anomalies, growth hormone therapy

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus, Disease Sub-limits (discount), Accidental Death Cover, Cashless Discount, No Claim Discount
